off_product.json is a trimmed response from the Open Food Facts API (product 3017620422003), data under the ODbL.

daybook_export_v1.json is an export in schema version 1, kept so that a later schema change cannot silently break old backups. Version 1 was amended once before any release. After the first release this file is never edited; a new schema version gets a new file next to it.
